name: Cooling-tower / closed-loop / boiler water-treatment route for Chicago high-rise and mid-size buildings
summary: Monthly chemical-treatment programmes (scale/corrosion/biocide), testing, controller management and ASHRAE 188 water-management-plan support for condo/co-op high-rises, hotels, independent hospitals and mid-size institutional buildings in Cook County, sold to boards, property managers and chief engineers. Founder runs the first ~20 accounts as route technician under a contracted experienced water technologist (CWT); private-label chemistry from a toll blender. Stage D batch DI, 2026-11-28.
evidence_notes: Public award prices are A-level: VA Illiana boiler + cooling-tower programme $32,512/yr with 12 offers (DI-S005); Cook County Facilities Mgmt water treatment & testing $349,541 for 2024-27 (DI-S004); City of Chicago H-O-H awards $3.88M (2016-21) and $4.32M (2022-27) (DI-S001); Columbus GA same-scope bids $29.4k-$78.0k/yr (C1-S006).

Chemical unit prices are A-level but out-of-state and 2021: Maine state contract cooling inhibitor $23.97-30.48/gal, oxidising biocide $10.60/gal, non-oxidising biocide $30.40/gal, closed-loop nitrite $13.73/gal (DI-S007). Toll-blender/private-label buy prices for a newcomer are MISSING (no blender publishes terms).
Private-building programme pricing ($500-850/month per building) is an E-level estimate triangulated from the public awards; no published private price list was found.
Labour cost proxies are C-level BLS OEWS 2025 Chicago MSA means: HVAC mechanics $79,340, chemical technicians $66,160 (DI-S015).

CWT designation needs 5 years' water-treatment experience (a technical degree credits 2 years) (DI-S008): the founder cannot be the credentialed technologist before ~2029, so a contracted CWT is modelled from month 1.

Illinois pesticide rules (8 IAC 250.120) have no cooling-tower category; whether biocide application for hire needs an IDOA or IDPH licence still requires direct confirmation (DI-S010). Insurance premiums are E.
All funnel and churn rates are E (no newcomer win-rate data exists).

No dedicated sales hire is modelled: at ~$650/month per building a $10k/month technical account manager adding ~0.8 accounts/month does not pay back within 3 years (tested), so growth stays founder- and referral-led (G7 risk).

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Time to sign a contract CWT, open blender/test-lab accounts, bind GL+pollution+professional insurance, and confirm the IDOA/IDPH biocide position (DI-S008, DI-S010); analyst estimate.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Stage C memo: 2-6 months, switching triggered by failures or renewal (WS11-017 Stage C). Condo boards meet monthly (E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified site conversations (chief engineer / board / property manager) per month while also running the route. Public permit data lists 211 Chicago addresses with cooling-tower permits since 2006 (DI-S002) and 658 benchmarked buildings over 250k sq ft (DI-S003), so lead supply is not the constraint.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Analyst estimate: proposal requires a site survey + water analysis.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: No newcomer data. Public bids are very competitive (12 offers on VA Illiana, DI-S005); private boards are relationship-driven. Analyst estimate.
drivers.rep_ramp_months__source: Analyst estimate for a technical account manager.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Property-management firms (e.g., FirstService Residential appears as owner's agent on a 2025 cooling-tower permit, DI-S002) control many buildings; analyst estimate.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Multi-year relationships; switching friction (controllers, programme knowledge) per Stage C. Annual churn 8-17%. Analyst estimate.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Per-building programme fee incl. chemicals, monthly visit, testing and reports. Triangulated from A-level public awards: VA Illiana 16 boilers + tower $32,512/yr (DI-S005), Columbus multi-building $29.4k-78.0k/yr (C1-S006), Cook County $116.5k/yr average across facilities (DI-S004). Private mid-size price list MISSING.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Start-up cleaning/passivation, controller or feed-equipment sale, water-management-plan drafting. Controller bid prices $3,958-5,816 each (A, C1-S007); attach rate is E.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: COGS = chemicals at blender cost + test reagents + Legionella lab tests. Chemical end-prices from Maine state contract (A, DI-S007, 2021); blender buy-price assumed 40-55% of that end-price (E, MISSING). Technician labour is modelled as staff, not COGS.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Equipment resale margin (dealer cost MISSING); analyst estimate.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Fuel, drum delivery, payment processing; analyst estimate.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Water-analysis lab fees, survey time/travel, samples; analyst estimate.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: BOMA/IFMA/condo-association event fees, website; analyst estimate.
drivers.dso_days__source: Net-30/45 B2B per Stage C; condo associations pay monthly via managers.
drivers.inventory_days_cogs__source: Drum stock at a small flex-space unit; analyst estimate.
drivers.dpo_days__source: Blender credit terms MISSING; net-30 assumed (requires direct confirmation).
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Covers capex, insurance and the contracted-CWT retainer before route density; analyst estimate.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Small service-business SDE multiple; analyst estimate.
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Set to 0 so peak funding shows business capital need only; founder living costs are an opportunity cost, not modelled.

staff.role: Contracted CWT technical advisor (programme design, sign-off, troubleshooting)
staff.notes: E: retainer for ~15-25 h/month from an experienced Certified Water Technologist; availability and rate MISSING (DI-S008 sets the 5-year experience bar).

C/E: BLS OEWS 2025 Chicago means HVAC mechanics $79,340 / chemical technicians $66,160 (DI-S015) + ~25% load; ~45 buildings per technician (E). Founder runs the first ~30 buildings himself (~90-110 route hours/month), then hires.
